source_field_semantics.yes: The client inventory classifies the row as active-outdated and requiring remediation.
source_field_semantics.no: The client inventory does not classify the row as active-outdated; firmware observed on these rows is client-accepted baseline evidence.
source_field_semantics.authority_ceiling: Client estate classification evidence only. It does not prove vendor-global latest firmware, package availability, management entitlement, or update authorization.

observed_client_accepted_candidates.basis: Observed in the client source where Active Outdated is No.
observed_client_accepted_candidates.ambiguity: This numerically older version is still accepted by the client classification. The reason is unresolved and must remain explicit.

observed_client_accepted_candidates.basis: Observed in the client source where Active Outdated is No.

selection.ordering: compare every dot-separated numeric component as an integer tuple
selection.rationale: Use the highest observed client-accepted candidate as the default planning target while authoritative estate-specific package mapping remains unresolved.
supersession_requires: stronger H&H estate-specific management-plane or owner evidence
a client source revision that changes the accepted candidate set

ambiguities.question: Why does the client source accept a numerically older firmware version, and is that classification current?
ambiguities.handling: Do not discard the row, relabel it as outdated, or treat it as the rollout target solely to remove the inconsistency. Carry the ambiguity into management-plane clarification.

candidate_order.evidence_basis: Public PAX/AxiaMed documentation identifies Control Center as a cloud payment-device management surface for PAX Android devices with remote update capability; current Bank of America Payment Fusion documentation exposes terminal inventory and application/settings management. Operator-managed H&H field evidence is materially consistent with this stack.
candidate_order.next_discriminator: Use already-authorized Payment Fusion Control Center or Healthcare Omni-Channel access to locate one representative terminal and inspect its software/update controls. If access is denied, record CREDENTIAL_GATE for this named surface; do not replace it with a generic owner-identification request.

candidate_order.evidence_basis: The H&H reader Connectivity Test exposes PAX Store Push Service Primary on TCP 443, while PAX documentation supports over-the-air firmware push to individual terminals and terminal groups.
candidate_order.next_discriminator: Use already-authorized PAXSTORE access to locate one representative terminal, inspect App & Firmware or Push Firmware, and determine whether the selected planning target package is exposed. If access is denied, record CREDENTIAL_GATE for PAXSTORE.

candidate_order.evidence_basis: Public PAX A80 deployments from other providers demonstrate terminal-initiated TMS application or firmware pull workflows, but no H&H/AxiaMed local TMS update control is currently proven.
candidate_order.next_discriminator: Inspect only already-exposed read-only AxiaMed or admin surfaces for NTMS, TMS, Update, or Firmware controls. Never alter a TMS endpoint, erase settings, reset the reader, or infer H&H applicability from another provider's guide.

candidate_order.evidence_basis: Some managed PAX estates apply software or firmware automatically when terminals check in, but no H&H-specific automatic-update policy is currently proven.
candidate_order.next_discriminator: Treat automatic update as supported only when estate-specific management evidence or directly observed representative-terminal behavior proves that policy.

required_markers: machine policy is the source of truth

proof_ceiling: Repository policy proves how client inventory evidence is interpreted and how the fleet-level default planning candidate is selected. It does not prove a site-authorized execution target, vendor-global latest firmware, package entitlement, supported assignment, a successful update, or production rollout acceptance.

resolution_evidence: authoritative H&H site/hospital owner or management-plane evidence
an explicit registered site override when the site operates independently or differs from the organization baseline
